# Vendored: safe-research/policy-engine

Unmodified copies from [safe-research/policy-engine](https://github.com/safe-research/policy-engine) at commit
`71b9cb08b9b7090ca8e11d250cb02a650a4aa0d3` (2026-10-01), licensed LGPL-3.0-only (see `LICENSE`).

- `interfaces/`, `libraries/`: what policies in this package implement and use (`IPolicy`, `AccessSelector`, …).
- `SafePolicyGuard.sol`, `core/`, `policies/ERC20TransferPolicy.sol`: used by the tests only, to exercise the new
  policies through the real guard and to compose them with an existing policy.

Do not edit these files; re-vendor from a newer commit instead.
